- **Problem**: A limit-stopped embed pass skips mirror verification, so GC runs the full vec0 count while holding the write lease. The budget is checked after the count. With two million mirrored variants and one due candidate, two consecutive GC calls on this path took about 398 ms and 394 ms against the 250 ms budget.
